value.behaviour: Unit-test range normalization, channel-independent splitting/merging, edit-time shifting, wrapped-line projection, `newTextElement` omission, Canvas 2D per-run rendering across alignments and themes, and `ElementsDelta` undo/redo.
rules: 1. Test `normalizeTextRanges` clamping out-of-bounds/negative indices, dropping inverted/empty (`start >= end`) or transparent/empty-colour entries, merging adjacent spans with identical `{ color, highlightColor }`, and omitting the array (`undefined`) when all spans are cleared.

2. Test `applyTextRangeStyle` splitting overlapping spans independently per channel (`color` on `[0, 6)` + `highlightColor` on `[3, 9)` -> `[0, 3)` color, `[3, 6)` color+highlight, `[6, 9)` highlight) and clearing a channel when `"transparent"` or `baseStrokeColor` is applied.

3. Test `computeTextEditDelta` and `shiftTextRangesOnEdit` for inserting before/inside/after a styled range, deleting a slice overlapping or enclosing a range (removing emptied ranges and returning `undefined`), and replacing a slice.
4. Test `projectTextRangesToLines` across hard `\n` breaks and soft-wrapped lines where `wrapText` trimmed boundary spaces.
5. Test `newTextElement` omitting `textRanges` as an own property (`"textRanges" in el === false`) when no valid ranges are supplied, and retaining normalized `textRanges` when supplied.

6. Test `renderElement` / `elementWithCanvasCache` drawing `fillRect` highlight boxes before `fillText` runs with `applyDarkModeFilter` in light and dark themes across `left`, `center`, and `right` `textAlign`, and regenerating the cached bitmap when `textRanges` changes.

7. Test `ElementsDelta.calculate` and `ElementsDelta.applyDelta` (forward and reverse) applying and undoing `textRanges` changes and removing the `textRanges` own property when undone back to unstyled state.

style_from.reason: Follows `@excalidraw/element` Vitest test structure and helper imports.

uses.reason: Tests Canvas 2D rendering and `elementWithCanvasCache` invalidation for `textRanges`.

tests.name: normalizes, clamps, sorts, and merges adjacent identical ranges and returns undefined when empty
tests.given: Unsorted, out-of-bounds, empty, transparent, and adjacent identical `TextRangeStyle` entries over a 10-char text
tests.expect: Returns sorted non-overlapping clamped spans with adjacent identical spans merged, or `undefined` when all spans are invalid/empty

tests.name: splits overlapping colour and highlight ranges independently per channel
tests.given: Range `[0, 6)` styled with `color: "#e03131"` and overlapping range `[3, 9)` styled with `highlightColor: "#ffec99"`
tests.expect: Produces `[{ start: 0, end: 3, color: "#e03131" }, { start: 3, end: 6, color: "#e03131", highlightColor: "#ffec99" }, { start: 6, end: 9, highlightColor: "#ffec99" }]`

tests.name: shifts, expands, trims, and removes ranges across insert, delete, and replace text edits
tests.given: Text `"Hello world"` with range `[6, 11)` styled and edits inserting `"brave "` at 6, inserting inside `[6, 11)`, and deleting `[6, 11)`
tests.expect: Shifts range to `[12, 17)` on prefix insert, expands range on interior insert, and returns `undefined` when the styled substring is deleted

tests.name: projects originalText ranges onto soft-wrapped and hard-wrapped lines
tests.given: Text `"  Hello  World"` wrapped to `"  Hello\nWorld"` with a range spanning `[2, 14)`
tests.expect: Projects onto line 0 run `"Hello"` (`[2, 7)`) and line 1 run `"World"` (`[9, 14)`) skipping soft-wrap trimmed spaces

tests.name: omits textRanges own property on newTextElement when empty and renders per-run fillRect and fillText on canvas
tests.given: An unstyled `newTextElement` and a styled `newTextElement` rendered across `left`, `center`, and `right` alignments in light and dark themes
tests.expect: `"textRanges" in unstyled === false`; canvas context executes `fillRect` before `fillText` with dark-mode-filtered colours and aligned `x` coordinates

tests.name: applies and reverses ElementsDelta for textRanges without leaving undefined own properties
tests.given: A text element transitioning from unstyled to styled `textRanges` and back via `ElementsDelta`
tests.expect: Forward delta sets `textRanges` and reverse delta deletes `textRanges` so `"textRanges" in restored === false`

value.behaviour: Test WYSIWYG substring range colour and highlight application, live edit-time display while `textWysiwyg` is open, live typing range shifts/deletions, collapsed-selection fallback, and undo/redo.
rules: 2. Add a `describe("per-range text styling", ...)` block at the end of `textWysiwyg.test.tsx` testing: (a) selecting `[0, 5)` in the open `<textarea>`, applying `actionChangeStrokeColor` and `actionChangeHighlightColor`, and asserting while `textWysiwyg` is still open that `editor.style.color === "transparent"`, `JSON.parse(editor.dataset.textRanges!)` matches the styled span, and `h.app.renderer.getRenderableElements({ ...h.state, elements: h.app.scene.getNonDeletedElements(), newElement: h.state.newElement }).elementsMap.get(textElement.id)?.textRanges` contains the live styled range (`FR-9`, `AC-3`); (b) submitting and verifying `textElement.textRanges` persists while `textElement.strokeColor` is unchanged (`AC-1`); (c) typing before/inside/deleting the styled substring in `textWysiwyg` shifts/expands/removes `textRanges` and omits the `textRanges` own property when emptied (`FR-5`, `AC-7`); (d) changing stroke colour with a collapsed selection (`selectionStart === selectionEnd`) updates `textElement.strokeColor` without adding `textRanges` (`FR-4`); (e) undoing and redoing range styling via `Keyboard.undo()` and `Keyboard.redo()` (`FR-12`, `AC-1`).
